title: Review and approve the architecture
acceptance: Owner decisions P01-P10 are recorded; unresolved matters have explicit before-use gates.

title: Repository, locked environments and CI
acceptance: A clean checkout runs formatting/static checks and dependency validation without hidden local configuration.

title: Local services, configuration and health
acceptance: Documented PostgreSQL/Redis environment starts; missing secrets fail safely and readiness reports dependency failures.

title: Schema migration and runtime role foundation
acceptance: Clean-database upgrades work; runtime roles cannot migrate or bypass intended tenant boundaries; expand/contract policy is documented.

title: OIDC sessions and memberships
acceptance: Issuer/audience/signature/expiry and session defenses are tested; unauthorized organization selection is rejected.

title: Tenant RLS, resource grants and audit
acceptance: API/SQL/pool/cache negative access tests deny every prohibited fixture; admin metadata access does not imply private-content access.

title: Quarantined upload and immutable completion
acceptance: Documented object-storage environment starts for quarantined uploads; real type/size/checksum validation rejects unsafe inputs; reused upload capability cannot mutate accepted processing bytes.

title: Durable jobs, outbox and reconciliation
acceptance: Duplicate delivery, broker loss and crashes around commit/ack produce one publication effect or a visible terminal failure.

title: Parsing, OCR, locators and chunk profiles
acceptance: PDF/DOCX/TXT fixtures retain real locators; OCR/table failures and empty parses are visible; parser isolation limits hold.

title: Atomic versions, updates and deletion
acceptance: Failed updates retain prior publication; tombstones block access; stale workers cannot publish; dependent live copies are purged with receipts.

title: Hybrid retrieval, reranking and citations
acceptance: Authorized labeled queries meet reviewed recall targets; citations resolve real permitted versions; selective-ACL behavior is measured.

title: Structured import and canonical snapshots
acceptance: CSV/XLSX schema/decimal/date/null/formula policies are explicit; invalid datasets fail visibly; immutable snapshots preserve provenance.

title: Metric registry and typed plan compiler
acceptance: Approved metric/date/currency/grain definitions compile only allowlisted operations; golden totals/growth/joins match expected decimal results.

title: Isolated analytics and typed result provenance
acceptance: File/network/extension/unauthorized-object attempts are denied; CPU/memory/time/temp-disk limits terminate overruns; results pin plan and source versions.

title: Approved read-only PostgreSQL connector
acceptance: Credential references, egress/SSRF controls, approved catalog, read-only roles, query limits and snapshot/freshness behavior pass integration review.

title: Bounded query orchestration and evidence answers
acceptance: Document, analytics, combined, clarification and abstention routes pass; budgets are bounded; access is rechecked before final release.

title: Typed chart specifications
acceptance: Every plotted point maps to a typed result; units/series/callback restrictions and accessible table fallback pass checks.

title: Private dashboards and CSV/PDF reports
acceptance: Refresh/export reauthorizes dependencies, limits fan-out, shows stale/partial state, and prevents formula/renderer injection.

title: Enterprise workflows and administration UI
acceptance: Workspace/upload/chat/citation/dashboard/admin journeys pass browser and keyboard/accessibility checks with synthetic tenants.

title: Quality and regression release gates
acceptance: Deterministic and held-out retrieval/claim/metric suites publish reproducible results; changes cannot bypass reviewed thresholds.

title: Adversarial, isolation and load evaluation
acceptance: Negative access, malicious input, revocation, noisy-neighbor, provider-throttle and query-exhaustion suites report observed limits without benchmark extrapolation claims.

title: HA deployment, IaC and safe rollout
acceptance: Approved-region services deploy from reviewed configuration; readiness/failover and compatible migration/rollback behavior are demonstrated.

title: Restore, deletion and incident drills
acceptance: Measured restore validates RPO/RTO, source consistency, deletion-ledger replay, fenced old workers and access before reopening.

title: Cost, quotas and scale decision review
acceptance: Per-tenant spend/admission controls work; actual saturation/skew evidence supports keep/change decisions for cells/search/warehouse/Kubernetes.

title: Operator, developer and interview mastery docs
acceptance: Another engineer can run, debug and operate the system from docs; owner can defend architecture and explain major implementations.

title: Production readiness and owner release review
acceptance: Functional/security/quality/load/recovery evidence and policy approvals are reviewed; limitations and residual risks are accepted explicitly before launch.
